evidence_items.claim: UBS is a FINOS Platinum member and joined when Symphony Software Foundation became FINOS in 2018
evidence_items.excerpt: UBS was announced as a new Platinum Member when the Symphony Software Foundation rebranded and launched as FINOS in April 2018.
evidence_items.caveats: Platinum membership indicates strong commitment. Confirmed active through 2025.

evidence_items.claim: UBS is active on FINOS Technical Oversight Committee and helped lead Open Source Readiness SIG

evidence_items.caveats: Governance role indicates strategic commitment to FINOS ecosystem.

evidence_items.caveats: EMIR compliance confirmed but method (CDM-based vs traditional) not specified. Uses ISDA Amend for data collection.
